product_one_liner.value: Octopus Deploy is a continuous-delivery platform for software teams that provides release orchestration, deployment automation, and runbook automation.
product_one_liner.notes: The product documentation describes Octopus as a continuous-delivery platform for modern software teams and lists release orchestration, deployment automation, and runbook automation.

pricing_page.notes: Octopus has a page titled pricing, and the page displays a yearly USD price; therefore it is a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company page labels its customer-logo area as organizations that deploy with Octopus and shows Coca-Cola, Nike, and Domino’s. | named_customers.0: Coca-Cola appears in the customer-logo section headed “Thousands of organizations deploy with Octopus.” | named_customers.1: Nike appears in the customer-logo section headed “Thousands of organizations deploy with Octopus.” | named_customers.2: Domino’s appears in the customer-logo section headed “Thousands of organizations deploy with Octopus.”

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 328 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile identifies Brisbane as the headquarters city. | hq_country: The company profile states its headquarters as Brisbane, Australia.

founded_year.notes: The company page marks 2012 as the year founded; its leadership biography also says the founder started Octopus in 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering archive lists an Octopus MCP Server post authored by Andrew Best; the post discusses the server and its architecture, while the company identifies Best as CTO leading engineering. A second post describes how an AI incident bot is built and is authored by a Lead Open Source Engineer. These are at least two technical, product-building posts by engineering staff.

public_docs.notes: Octopus maintains a publicly accessible Documentation and Support site at /docs, whose opening documentation page describes the product and its capabilities.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Greenhouse listings show a Senior Data Engineer at most in the engineering/data listing, and the other current board shows revenue-systems roles and expressions of interest. Neither listing includes an AI, ML, data-science, LLM, NLP, or other qualifying title; data engineer alone does not meet the specified title criteria.

model_provider.value: Anthropic (users supply an Anthropic API key and choose the model).
model_provider.notes: The Octopus AI documentation says users bring their own Anthropic API key and choose the model, publicly identifying Anthropic as a supported provider rather than claiming one fixed model.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Octopus Trust Center compliance line explicitly names SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, GDPR, and PCI DSS; those are the requested certifications present on that page. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly names GDPR. | compliance_certs.3: The Trust Center explicitly names PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile identifies the most recent round as Series B. | funding_date: The funding profile dates the latest Series B round to 2025-10-08, which is represented at the requested month granularity as 2025-10. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile lists the latest round as Series B and reports its amount as USD 30,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding announcement reports a USD 30 million round on October 8, 2025, which falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Octopus Greenhouse application page is for a Business Development Representative in Singapore and presents an Apply action, satisfying the requested BDR category.

launched_6mo.notes: Octopus announced Feature Flags in Public Preview on July 13, 2026; this was a product-feature launch within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The executive-movement notice says Chief Revenue Officer Harsh Sabikhi left Octopus Deploy, posted July 21, 2026; this is a C-level departure within the 12 months before 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Revenue Systems Specialist posting says the team owns HubSpot and is moving from Salesforce to HubSpot, explicitly identifying both systems in the revenue stack. | crm_stack_signal.0: The revenue-systems job posting explicitly names HubSpot as the center of the revenue stack. | crm_stack_signal.1: The revenue-systems job posting explicitly names Salesforce as the system being migrated from.
